key_concepts: Living things need a healthy environment to meet their basic needs
Basic needs from the environment include air, water, food, shelter, and clothing
The environment gives fresh air, clean water, and soil for planting
Protecting the environment helps prevent floods, typhoons, and other accidents
Planting trees helps protect and conserve the environment
Closing taps and switching off lights when not in use saves water and electricity
Using reusable bags and saying no to plastic reduces waste
Carpooling, walking, or biking reduces air pollution and fuel use
Garbage should be thrown in trash cans and separated properly
Burning leaves or plastic and throwing garbage in canals harm the environment
Composting leaves and cleaning canals or rivers help conserve the environment
